eras.title: Install
eras.body: Double-click Finn-Setup for your OS. No Terminal. The API starts with the app.

eras.title: Welcome
eras.body: Open Finn. Confirm how tools run. Name the first Space and paste scope.

eras.title: Workstation
eras.body: Terminal is home. Finn sits beside it. Approve every command, or YOLO when the scope is yours.

macos.name: macOS

primary.label: macOS installer (pkg)
primary.action: Double-click. Apple Installer runs Finn Setup.

also.label: macOS Setup (DMG)
also.action: Open the disk image, then double-click Finn Setup.app.

also.label: macOS kit (zip)
also.action: Unzip, then double-click Finn Setup.app. Do not use the Python wheel zip.

first_launch: Open Finn Pentest Harness. The API starts with the app — do not run finn api in another terminal.

If macOS says the app cannot be opened or is damaged, that is Gatekeeper quarantine on a GitHub download. Double-click fix-gatekeeper.command next to the app, or run xattr -cr on the .pkg / .app / .dmg, then Right-click → Open.
Grant Local Network when asked (required). Files & Folders for reports. Accessibility is optional (⌘⇧F summon).

windows.name: Windows

primary.label: Windows installer
primary.action: Double-click. NSIS wizard, Start Menu + desktop shortcut named Finn. WebView2 is installed if missing. Python for the API is bundled.

first_launch: Open Finn from the Start Menu or the desktop shortcut. The API starts with the app.
Do not run finn api / finn server in a second window.
If Windows SmartScreen warns on a GitHub download, More info → Run anyway. Launch as a normal user, not Administrator.

linux.name: Linux

primary.label: Linux (deb)
primary.action: Open in Software Center, or: sudo dpkg -i Finn-Setup.deb

also.label: Linux (rpm)
also.action: Open in the distro installer, or: sudo rpm -i Finn-Setup.rpm

first_launch: Open Finn from the app menu, or run the AppImage. The API starts with the app.
Need GTK/WebKit only when building from source (libgtk-3-dev, libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev).
Do not run the desktop binary as root.

web.name: Browser

primary.label: Workstation in the browser
primary.action: cd web && npm install && npm run dev — then open /app. Marketing routes do not need the API.

first_launch: The desktop app is the normal install. The browser workstation talks to the same local API.
Create a Space, paste scope, press ⌘K to scan.
